answer_4.quote: Interpretations of XCB on MIMIC-CXR were evaluated by a practicing radiologist through a set of ten questions. ... We provide human experts with a set of images and pieces of text representing underlying concept in the framework.
answer_4.guideline: A sample question consists of five X-ray images with associated tokens; the radiologist must select which token is irrelevant, i.e., assess relevance of textual interpretations to the images.
